I work by appointment only, in person across the Denver Metro area, from Loveland to Castle Rock (farther for an added travel fee), or remotely by phone, WhatsApp, and email.

How to reach me

Call or text (303) 500-4122 WhatsApp (same number) (303) 500-4122 Email placasfirmas.david@gmail.com

Appointments, payment & locations

By appointment only

Regular appointment hours: Monday–Friday, 10 AM – 7 PM.

After hours (7 PM – 10 AM): +$20. Weekends: +$15.

Payment methods

100% upfront: cash, Venmo, Zelle, bank transfer (ACH), or card (credit card payments have a 2% processing surcharge; debit cards have none).

Where we meet

I come to you anywhere in Colorado (mobile fee) or we meet at a Community Hub: Tienda Salvadoreña, MSU Denver, or any Denver Public Library branch. These are public places where I meet clients by appointment; I am not affiliated with or endorsed by them.

All fees, premiums, and packages are on the Services page. I always confirm your total in writing before your appointment.

Before your appointment

  • Valid, unexpired ID
  • All signers present
  • Know which forms you need

I am a Notary Public commissioned in Colorado (ID 20254044224). Certificate of insurance available on request.

Mandatory disclosure: I am not an attorney licensed to practice law in the State of Colorado and I may not give legal advice or accept fees for legal advice. I am not an immigration consultant, nor am I an expert on immigration matters. If you suspect fraud, you may contact the Colorado attorney general’s office or the Colorado supreme court. I cannot tell you what forms you need or how to fill them out to achieve a legal result.

Notice: Ayuda DMV is an independent service and is not affiliated with the Colorado DMV, USCIS, or any government agency. All of my services are clerical, notarial, or translation support only; I do not represent clients before any agency.

AI & privacy: I may use AI as a clerical tool to organize or translate documents, but I personally review and edit every document before delivery. I never enter personal information (SSNs, full names, addresses) into public AI systems, and AI makes no decisions: you always work with me, a real person.
